<issue>
[BUG] DescribeDBSubnetGroups: empty list instead of DBSubnetGroupNotFoundFault
## Service

RDS

## AWS API Action

DescribeDBSubnetGroups

## AWS Documentation

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeDBSubnetGroups.html

If `DBSubnetGroupName` does not exist → `DBSubnetGroupNotFoundFault` (HTTP 404).

## Expected behavior

```bash
aws rds describe-db-subnet-groups --db-subnet-group-name does-not-exist
```

→ error `DBSubnetGroupNotFoundFault`.

## Actual behavior

Floci returns HTTP 200:

```json
{
  "DBSubnetGroups": []
}
```

## Reproduction

```bash
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1
export AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:4566

aws rds describe-db-subnet-groups \
  --db-subnet-group-name does-not-exist \
  --output json
```

## Environment

- Floci version / image tag: nightly
- Running: Docker (port 4566)


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find the RDS DescribeDBSubnetGroups implementation (grep -ri "SubnetGroup" in src/main). Report file paths and line numbers of the handler for DescribeDBSubnetGroups and the service method it calls, and any existing DBSubnetGroupNotFound error usage, with code snippets.

content.content: {"summary":"DescribeDBSubnetGroups is dispatched in RdsQueryHandler and calls RdsService.listDbSubnetGroups. That method never throws DBSubnetGroupNotFoundFault. A filter name that doesn't exist just returns an empty list.","findings":["Dispatch: RdsQueryHandler.java:59 `case \"DescribeDBSubnetGroups\" -> handleDescribeDbSubnetGroups(params, region);` (src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/rds/)","Handler: RdsQueryHandler.java:266-278 `handleDescribeDbSubnetGroups`. It reads `params.getFirst(\"DBSubnetGroupName\")`, calls `service.listDbSubnetGroups(filterName, region)`, and wraps each group in `<DBSubnetGroup>` inside `<DBSubnetGroups>`. It catches AwsException and returns AwsQueryResponse.error(e.getErrorCode(), ...).","Service: RdsService.java:796-811. The overload `listDbSubnetGroups(String filterName)` at 796 delegates to `listDbSubnetGroups(String filterName, String region)` at 800. When the filter is blank or \"default\", the default group is added via buildDefaultSubnetGroup. When a filter is given, `subnetGroups.get(filterName).ifPresent(groups::add)` runs and the method returns, so an unknown name gives an empty list with no error. With no filter, it adds `subnetGroups.scan(k -> true)`.","Existing DBSubnetGroupNotFoundFault usage in RdsService.java: line 823 (resolveDbSubnetGroupView, 404), line 879 (getDbSubnetGroup(name, region), 404), line 901 (deleteDbSubnetGroup, 404), line 1240 (inside the DB instance creation path, when the instance's subnet group is looked up, 404).","Example snippet, RdsService.java:879: `return subnetGroups.get(name).orElseThrow(() -> new AwsException(\"DBSubnetGroupNotFoundFault\", \"DB subnet group \" + name + \" not found.\", 404));`","AwsQueryController.java:366 lists DescribeDBSubnetGroups among the RDS actions it recognises."],"confidence":0.95}
